dialogue.realtalk: A private chat? With you? I've had worse afternoons, %1$s.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.good: Better now. Funny how that works when you show up.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.rough: Rough day — but you asking about it? That's the first nice thing that's happened.
dialogue.realtalk.day.good: It just got better. Coincidence? I don't think so.
dialogue.realtalk.day.rough: Terrible, thanks for asking. Stay a while and fix the average.
dialogue.realtalk.work.like: I'm very good at it, you know. I'm very good at a lot of things.
dialogue.realtalk.life.first: My life story? Buy me a drink first. Fine, fine — chapter one...
dialogue.realtalk.dreams.first: Lately? Someone keeps showing up in them. Handsome nuisance. No, I won't say who.
dialogue.realtalk.fears.first: Promise not to use it against me? ...Ending up alone. There. Now you owe me a secret.
dialogue.realtalk.feelings.first: Finally, the interesting questions. Let's just say you're not nothing, %1$s. Far from it.
dialogue.realtalk.regrets.first: A few. Mostly people I let walk away too easily. I'm working on not repeating that.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.personal: So forward! I like it. But you'll have to work for that one, %1$s.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.intimate: Sweet thing, that question is fourth-date material and you know it.
dialogue.realtalk.gossip.none: No news, unless you count me being this charming with no audience.
dialogue.realtalk.us.happy.yes: Deliriously. Obviously. Have you seen who I married?
dialogue.realtalk.us.firstmet.memory: You stared. Don't rewrite history, %1$s — you stared first, and I let you.
